name: TruckWys golden ledger: Q3 2026 (July-September)
description: System-neutral accounting dataset. Replay it into any ledger (TruckWys services, Xero, QuickBooks Online) and the figures in `expected` must come out to the cent. Money is ZAR, as strings, 2 decimals for totals. Apply customers, suppliers, then every invoice (created as draft from its lines, then issued unless its status is draft), then `events` strictly in array order, then expenses. `expected` is generated by core/tests/golden_reference.py and frozen; never hand-edit it.

rules.rounding: Per line: net = round_half_up(qty x unit_price - discount, 0.01); vat = round_half_up(net x rate, 0.01); document totals are sums of lines. Discount is before VAT; discount_percent applies to qty x unit_price.
rules.due_date: issue_date + N days for payment_terms NETN
rules.revenue: Accrual, excl. VAT: issued invoices by issue_date minus ISSUED credit notes by their own issue_date. Drafts and void invoices never count; voided credit notes never count.
rules.cash: Payments (after edits/deletes) by payment_date, incl. VAT. Cash revenue excl. VAT = sum over payments of round_half_up(applicable x invoice subtotal / invoice total), where applicable = min(amount, invoice total - earlier payments on that invoice) and never negative; the remainder is overpayment (customer credit).
rules.expenses: amount is gross incl. VAT. Input VAT = vat_amount when given, else round_half_up(gross x 15/115) for STANDARD, 0 otherwise. REJECTED expenses never count.
rules.ageing: As at D: issued invoices with issue_date <= D; outstanding = total - payments dated <= D - issued credit notes dated <= D; negative -> customer_credits; positive bucketed by D - due_date: <=0 current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, >90.
rules.status: Final invoice status with today = status_as_of (see golden_reference.py).
